# Third-Party Notices

Death Star keeps copied or adapted third-party material out of the runtime package unless the license permits runtime inclusion.

Each imported source should have a notice that records:
- upstream URL
- license
- upstream version or commit when available
- copied or adapted sections
- Death Star integration purpose

Copyleft or whole-application projects should be referenced here and invoked through CLI/container boundaries rather than copied into the core package path.
